messages:
ada-prod: @channel Quick notice: we're publishing a change to Private backup export encryption defaults for VPC/on-prem deployments. Effective in 21 days new exports will be encrypted with a customer-provided public key by default (if supplied). If no key is provided, exports remain server-side encrypted with tenant-scoped keys.

sam-ops: What triggers this change? Any customer incident?

ada-prod: Two drivers: (1) customer requests for tenant-controlled export keys, (2) recent audit feedback recommending customer-held encryption for export artifacts. No security incident triggered this.

lucy-legal: Legal summary: updated DPA language to note optional customer-supplied public keys for backup export encryption and export audit records. Customers must confirm they control the private key if they request key-holding. We also added deletion and access controls for exported artifacts.

ron-csm: What should CSMs tell customers who want to keep exports off our systems entirely?

ada-prod: Talk track: you can provide a public key at export time or set a default public key per deployment. If you want exports to never leave your network, use the non-exportable bundle option or run export locally for air-gapped installs. For FedRAMP/IL5-level requirements, route to Security + Sales.

sam-ops: Installer/CLI notes: for air-gapped installs the export command will write locally and will honor --encrypt-with. For VPC installs Console will ask admin to upload a public key or choose server-side encryption.

ada-prod: Example CLI snippets:
```bash
# export backup encrypted with a provided public key, saved locally
redwood private backup export --deployment prod-eu --encrypt-with /path/to/pubkey.pem --out /tmp/prod-eu-backup.tar.gpg

# set deployment default to require customer key (prevents server-side export)
redwood private update --deployment prod-eu --backup-export-mode require-customer-key
```

deploy-bot: Rollout note: config flag gated rollout starting 2026-10-01 01:00-03:00 UTC. No infra restart expected. Internal runbook: https://redwood.dev/internal/runbooks/private-backup-exports (internal).

lucy-legal: Action items: finalize DPA addendum + 2-sentence sales blurb (ETA 48h).

ron-csm: Action items: prepare CSM kit and canned email for customers in the backup/export pilot (ETA 72h).

sam-ops: Action items: add CI test to ensure installer enforces non-exportable mode for air-gapped profiles (ETA 5 days).

ada-prod: Thanks all. If you'd like to join the pilot or preview the Console flow, DM me. We'll post the public docs when GA is confirmed. :thumbsup:
